## Pipeline constants

CAUTION: `src/config.py` binds model geometry at IMPORT time from `ORIG_MODEL`. The values below
are therefore whatever `ORIG_MODEL` pointed at when this snapshot ran -- NOT a property of the
repository. To describe a specific run, set the same `ORIG_MODEL` this script saw. The env vars
are listed underneath precisely so the constants can be interpreted.
```

NUM_HIDDEN_LAYERS        64
```
